task_name: Northgrove - Wholesale lookbook and hang-tag system
client_brief:
A ten-look wholesale hang-tag run with properly matched product photography

Northgrove's fall capsule is heading to stockists. Our immediate need is a dependable hang-tag pack: the correct piece, its own image and the full make note on every card. The photography comes from two mornings that do not yet look like the same collection.

What we need back
- Wholesale capsule lookbook: 1 named export. Styles are identified accurately. The page sequence supports wholesale selection.
- Garment hang tag: 11 named exports. The garment facts match this style. The care wording remains readable at tag size.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Cut and sewn to outlast the season.
brand_identity.sector: Heritage workwear with cast metal hardware, wholesale to independent stockists plus direct sale, made in Burlington, Vermont.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Burlington, Vermont; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: NORTHGROVE is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Burlington, Vermont, and this commission covers phase 2: wholesale lookbook, hang tags and launch collateral.
brand_identity.audience: Buyers and wearers twenty eight to forty five who value provenance and construction over logos, and who read fabric and make before they read a brand mark.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Seventy four to one hundred twenty eight dollars per piece, mid premium wholesale and direct. Muted grounds, full frame photography that shows cloth and seam, and copy that leads on material and make. Deliberately clear of both the twenty four dollar fast fashion grid and the price free editorial luxury a buyer cannot work from.
brand_identity.typography: The wordmark is a charcoal condensed lockup beside a small olive leaf glyph. A condensed grotesque display carries headers, look titles and the poster; a sturdy text face carries the season statement, fabric and make notes, and the linesheet price grid. Heritage and plain, never costume.
brand_identity.voice: Understated and maker focused, provenance before promotion. Example line the brand would write: 'Ten pieces, cut and sewn in Burlington, meant to be worn hard.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The NORTHGROVE wordmark and olive leaf glyph are set. The whole capsule was shot flat, overhead, on a mid gray backdrop across two mornings, with the cast hardware shot separately on the bench. The collaborating club has no artwork left: its crest survives only as a photograph of an old wool pennant on a wall. Last season's hang tag exists as the printer's press file, same size and stock this year.
brand_identity.values: Locally made, built to last. Provenance and construction over logos, and partnerships that stay neighbourly.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
